snippet.title: The Start To Each Route!!!!(Part 1)(My Doki Doki SNAFU MOD)
snippet.description:
The Synopsis: 
My Doki Doki SNAFU follows a re-envisioned MC as he joins the Literature Club and spends the semester learning more about its members while trying not to get caught up in their antics. Joy, sorrow, empathy... feel these and much more while playing through the routes of all your favorite Dokis!

The Details:
- 11 Total Routes: Every love interest has both a Date Route and a Friendship Route you can pursue.
- 200+ Appeal Scenes: Spend quality time with each girl as you progress your relationship.
- Stat System: Improve yourself to unlock new scenarios and better appeal to your favorite Doki.
- 15+ Hours of Original Content: Hope you didn't have any important plans coming up.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
